% algorithm2e's ruled algorithms, with vertical lines along their blocks
% and numbered lines, also in an [H] algorithm and in one in \small text,
% which has the lengths of the others. As in the PDF, the caption is at the
% left between two rules, at the top wherever \caption is, and a
% rule ends the body, all three as wide as the text. Each line is a
% paragraph, with its number in the margin and its keywords bold. A block's
% vertical line ends in a short rule unless an else follows. A \ref to an
% algorithm or to one of its lines leads there. No math follows a keyword
% or is in a comment: see "Small known differences" in CONTRIBUTING.md.
% The other styles, set with \RestyleAlgo, have their caption below the
% body, centered as in the PDF (plain, boxed, and plainruled), or above it
% at the left (boxruled and tworuled). Their frames and rules are not
% drawn: see DOCUMENTATION.md. \noalgocaption hides a ruled algorithm's
% caption. With \SetAlgoNoLine, blocks have no lines and end in a
% numbered end. No empty paragraph is between two [H] algorithms.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsmath}
\usepackage[ruled,vlined,linesnumbered]{algorithm2e}
\begin{document}
\section{Search}
Algorithm~\ref{alg:search} finds the smallest $i$ with $a_i \ge x$; its
loop ends at line~\ref{line:return}.
\begin{algorithm}
\caption{Binary search}\label{alg:search}
\KwIn{a sorted array $a_1 \le \dots \le a_n$ and a value $x$}
\KwOut{the least $i$ with $a_i \ge x$, or $n+1$}
$\ell \gets 1$, $h \gets n + 1$\tcp*{the answer lies between them}
\While{$\ell < h$}{
  $m \gets \lfloor (\ell + h)/2 \rfloor$\;
  \eIf{$a_m < x$}{
    $\ell \gets m + 1$\tcp*{too small: search the right half}
  }{
    $h \gets m$\;
  }
}
\Return{the index found}\label{line:return}\;
\For{$k = 1, \dots, K$}{
  $s_k \gets \sum_{j=1}^{k} a_j$\;
}
\end{algorithm}
Text after the algorithm.

\begin{algorithm}[H]
\DontPrintSemicolon
\KwData{a graph $G = (V, E)$}
\ForEach{$v \in V$}{
  \tcc{a comment on its own line}
  \uIf{$\deg v = 0$}{remove $v$}
  \ElseIf{$\deg v = 1$}{mark $v$}
  \Else{keep $v$}
}
\Repeat{no vertex is marked}{
  remove the marked vertices\label{line:remove}
}
\caption{An \texttt{[H]} algorithm, its caption at the end}\label{alg:prune}
\end{algorithm}
See Algorithm~\ref{alg:prune}, line~\ref{line:remove}.

\section{Other styles}
{\RestyleAlgo{plain}
\begin{algorithm}[H]
\caption{A plain algorithm}\label{alg:plain}
\eIf{$x > 0$}{
  $y \gets x$\;
}{
  $y \gets -x$\;
}
\end{algorithm}}
{\RestyleAlgo{boxed}
\begin{algorithm}[H]
\caption{A boxed algorithm}
$y \gets |x|$\;
\Return{the value}\;
\end{algorithm}}
{\RestyleAlgo{boxruled}
\begin{algorithm}[H]
$y \gets |x|$\;
\Return{the value}\;
\caption{A boxruled algorithm}
\end{algorithm}}
{\RestyleAlgo{plainruled}
\begin{algorithm}[H]
\caption{A plainruled algorithm}
$y \gets |x|$\;
\Return{the value}\;
\end{algorithm}}
{\RestyleAlgo{tworuled}
\begin{algorithm}[H]
\SetAlgoNoLine
\caption{A tworuled algorithm without lines}
\While{$\ell < h$}{
  \eIf{$a_m < x$}{
    $\ell \gets m + 1$\;
  }{
    $h \gets m$\;
  }
}
\end{algorithm}}
{\noalgocaption
\begin{algorithm}[H]
\caption{A caption that is not shown}\label{alg:nocaption}
$y \gets |x|$\;
\end{algorithm}}
See Algorithm~\ref{alg:nocaption}.
